turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no hour-of-day breakdown, so I cannot name the peak checkout hour. The closest metric, Checkout sessions (site sessions with a checkout, counted on the day of the checkout, by day only), shows 2 checkout sessions over 20 September to 3 October 2026 (1 on 1 October and 1 on 3 October). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
